facts: Online maths tuition: KS2, KS3 and GCSE. Small groups have five learners.
Group monthly fees: KS2 £40, KS3 £90, GCSE £100. One-to-one monthly fees: KS2 £60, KS3 £120, GCSE £140.
KS2 includes four one-hour lessons per month; KS3 and GCSE include eight 90-minute lessons.
In-person tuition is not currently offered.
usage: Owner-requested reuse of their website content and imagery. No customer testimonials, tutor identities, live availability or subscription checkout are invented.
